description: This file defines the SugarPHPMailer class, an extension of the PHPMailer library used in SuiteCRM for handling email functionalities. It includes configuration for SMTP, OAuth, attachments, embedded images, and outbound email processing specific to SuiteCRM's environment.

classes.name: SugarPHPMailer
classes.description: An extension of the PHPMailer class with added SuiteCRM-specific functionality for outbound email handling, including support for OAuth, embedded images, attachments, and custom logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarPHPMailer with environment-specific settings such as language, charset, and default SMTP configuration.

methods.name: setMailer
methods.description: Configures the mailer settings based on user mailer preferences.

methods.name: setSystemFromAddress
methods.description: Sets the system-wide default 'From' address and name for outgoing emails.

methods.name: setMailerForSystem
methods.description: Configures the mailer settings for system-wide email sending.

methods.name: initSMTPAuth
methods.description: Initializes SMTP authentication details based on auth type (basic or OAuth).

methods.name: initOAuth
methods.description: Sets up OAuth authentication with external providers for SMTP.

methods.name: prepForOutbound
methods.description: Prepares email content for outbound delivery, including charset translation and HTML formatting.

methods.name: replaceImageByRegex
methods.description: Replaces image URLs in email body with cid references and embeds images as attachments.

methods.name: handleAttachments
methods.description: Handles adding attachments and embedded images from notes and documents.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during email sending.

methods.name: smtpConnect
methods.description: Establishes an SMTP connection with logging.

methods.name: PreSend
methods.description: Ensures the email body is not empty before sending.

methods.name: embeddedAttachmentExists
methods.description: Checks if a file is already attached as an embedded image.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs variable substitution in email subject and body content.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Overrides PHPMailer::send to add logging and error handling.

methods.name: setSecureProtocol
methods.description: Sets the security protocol for SMTP (SSL/TLS).
